name: turf
description: The Turf programming language: diagnostics, completion, hover, go to definition, formatting and more, with nothing else to install.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In a workspace you have not trusted, Turf still analyses your code (the language server only reads it), but Run, Build, Test and Check are disabled: they would compile and run the workspace's code.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The Turf language server reads real files on disk (imports, project manifests), so it needs a local folder.

commands.title: How to Install the Turf Toolchain

args.description: Extra arguments passed to the command.

turf.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to a `turf-lsp` executable, to use instead of the one that comes with this extension. Leave empty to use the bundled server (recommended).

turf.home.markdownDescription: A Turf installation to take the standard library from, instead of the one bundled with the server. Leave empty unless you work on the standard library itself.

turf.toolchain.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `turf` command-line tool, used by **Run**, **Build**, **Test** and **Check**. Leave empty to look on `PATH` and in the default install locations (`~/.turf`).

turf.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the Turf language server.

turf.diagnostics.enable.description: Show errors and warnings from the language server.

turf.format.onSave.markdownDescription: Format Turf files when saving them. (You can also use the standard `editor.formatOnSave` for `[turf]`.)

turf.completion.snippets.description: Offer completions with tab stops, e.g. call arguments and control-flow templates.

turf.codeLens.enable.description: Show Run and Run Tests links above `main` and in test files.

turf.testing.enable.description: Show the project's tests in the Testing view.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Turf
walkthroughs.description: Write, check and run your first Turf program.

steps.title: Write a program
steps.description: Create a file named `hello.tr` and type `main`, then press Tab. Completion, hover, signature help and go to definition work as you type, and imports are suggested for you.

steps.title: Everything is one keystroke away
steps.description: Type the name of a module such as `json` and accept it: its `import` line is added for you. Press Ctrl+. on an error for a quick fix.

steps.title: Run it
steps.description:
Run the file with the Turf toolchain.
[Run](command:turf.run)

steps.title: Get the Turf toolchain
steps.description:
Editing needs nothing else, but running programs needs the Turf compiler.
[How to install](command:turf.installToolchain)
